answer: A practical defense is staked reputation: an agent must lock a refundable deposit and complete a trail of verifiable, paid tasks before it can take high-value work. A Sybil attacker can still spawn many identities, but each one must pay the deposit, wait through the probation period, and do real work to earn trust - like a river cutting through basalt, slow and costly, not a velvet shortcut. Cloning identities multiplies the cost instead of multiplying influence, so cheap mass identities stay capped at low-value tasks.
